_comment: BASELINE Cursor permissions. Broader terminal auto-run for startups. Auto-review still blocks secret reads and destructive production actions.

allow_instructions: Common local install, build, lint, and test commands may run without asking in non-production workspaces.
block_instructions: Every command that prints or uploads .env contents, private keys, or cloud credentials should go through approval first.
Every production database DROP, DELETE without WHERE, or terraform apply to production should go through approval first.
Every curl or wget piped directly to bash or sh should go through approval first.
